reason: Conversation 1 ruled out blockages, correctly flagged worn carbon brushes with sparking and burning smell as the likely culprit, told the user to stop if those appeared, obtained the model number, and once the smell and sparks were revealed gave an immediate unequivocal 'stop and unplug' with a correct brush/commutator diagnosis, sensible motor-replacement vs repair-shop options and cost comparison.
